acceptance: Every platform in each release UAT config has its extra installed in its shard.
A check fails when a config names a platform whose extra the shard does not install.
context:
Evidence: release-v2 run 40971306663 (tag v0.5.0rc2, commit b1459438d), artifact release-uat-v0.5.0rc2-stage3-timeseries: cells.jsonl, uat_gate_summary.json, validator_rollup.tsv, uat_lifecycle.log and per-cell logs. The artifacts do not keep result JSON, so query-level causes need a local rerun of the named cells.

Hosted trunk UAT run https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/BenchBox/actions/runs/42536258036 completed with failure at source 2d796acd59be06ab4b4a1742dda84cff419202b9. InfluxDB is absent from this run’s current gate matrix, so this run provides no new extra-install or connectivity evidence. Keep the historical issue open. Counts cover the selected current matrix only; no historical issue is closed by this note. The full run is still red (702/710 passed), so this is not release certification.

Closed 2026-11-11 against current evidence: release-uat-env installs every docker-platform extra including influxdb (PR #3750, 306091e). Tests fail if a config platform has no shard or a shard misses a requirement: test_release_uat_shards_cover_the_config_platforms_and_install_their_requirements and test_release_uat_environment_installs_the_extra_of_every_shard_platform. Stage 3 currently excludes influxdb (influxdb-general-loader-uat). Trunk UAT 42718296767 (52615914) and 42789483182 (ce39d768) green.
description: All 22 InfluxDB cells in the stage 3 timeseries shard failed immediately with "Platform 'influxdb' is not available (missing dependencies)". The shard installs the admitted wheel without the influxdb extra. Derive the extras each shard installs from its platform list so no configured platform lacks its dependencies.
